list.name: process_id
list.label: Process
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, process_id::text AS __value FROM polymarket.trading_processes WHERE config #>> '{execution,rail,name}' = 'polymarket' ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Shared order stages by origin
panels.description: Stage observations include retries and repeated reconciliation. They are not order counts or proof of a fill. Preview observations are separate from submission dispatch; dispatch is not an exchange acknowledgement.

panels.title: Recovery and unresolved evidence
panels.description: Process-scoped recovery evidence. Missing series are unknown, never zero. Recovery includes orders from both origins and does not fabricate an origin label.

panels.title: Execution freshness
panels.description: Existing freshness owner. Live timing is immediately before POST; paper timing is at simulated arrival. These observations do not claim identical external outcomes.

panels.title: Durable orders, fills and settlement
panels.description: Latest 200 orders created in the selected interval, with fills within that interval. Null economic evidence is unknown or absent, never a fabricated zero. Both API and UMR effects use the same ledger. Use the existing trading PnL dashboard for lifetime realized accounting.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id, process_id, state, created_at, raw_payload
 FROM polymarket.orders
 WHERE process_id=(${process_id:sqlstring})::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
   AND raw_payload #>> '{request,metadata,polymarket_execution,mode}' ~ ${execution_mode:sqlstring}
   AND raw_payload #>> '{request,metadata,polymarket_execution,origin}' ~ ${origin:sqlstring}
 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
), economics AS (
 SELECT o.order_id, SUM(f.size) AS shares, SUM(f.size*f.price) AS notional, SUM(f.fee) AS fees
 FROM selected o JOIN polymarket.fills f ON f.process_id=o.process_id AND f.order_id=o.order_id
 WHERE f.timestamp_utc >= $__timeFrom() AND f.timestamp_utc <= $__timeTo()
 GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT o.created_at AS time, o.order_id, o.state,
 o.raw_payload #>> '{request,metadata,polymarket_execution,mode}' AS execution_mode,
 o.raw_payload #>> '{request,metadata,polymarket_execution,origin}' AS origin,
 o.raw_payload #>> '{execution_resolution}' AS resolution,
 e.shares, e.notional, e.fees,
 s.credit_status, s.payout, s.net_pnl
FROM selected o LEFT JOIN economics e USING(order_id)
LEFT JOIN polymarket.btc_paper_settlement_ledger s ON s.process_id=o.process_id AND s.order_id=o.order_id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC;

panels.title: Order and settlement evidence
panels.description: Fields are extracted at query time from the bot JSON tracing envelope. Process/order/fill IDs are not Loki stream labels. Recovery events have no single origin and appear in the panel below.

targets.expr: {service_name="polymarket-bot"} | json process_id="fields.process_id", execution_mode="fields.execution_mode", origin="fields.origin", event="fields.event" | process_id="$process_id" | execution_mode=~"$execution_mode" | origin=~"$origin"

panels.title: Recovery and dependency logs
panels.description: Dependency failures remain action/process scoped. These alerts and logs do not change trading authorization.
